metadata.title: API Contract Drift Report (D0-D9 Taxonomy)
metadata.specification: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.5-A / DEC-041

taxonomyLegend.D1: MISSING_ENDPOINT — Endpoint expected by client missing from server
taxonomyLegend.D2: METHOD_MISMATCH — HTTP verb differs between client and server
taxonomyLegend.D3: PATH_PARAM_MISMATCH — Path parameter structure or naming differs
taxonomyLegend.D4: QUERY_PARAM_MISMATCH — Query parameter names or types differ
taxonomyLegend.D6: RESPONSE_ENVELOPE_MISMATCH — Response envelope does not conform to ApiSuccessEnvelope
taxonomyLegend.D7: ERROR_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH — Error response does not conform to ApiErrorEnvelope
taxonomyLegend.D8: AUTH_POLICY_MISMATCH — Auth requirement differs between client and server
taxonomyLegend.D9: UNVERSIONED_OR_DEPRECATED — Client targets legacy unversioned path

layer1_legacyDeclaredClientContractsChec.note: Verifies 9 explicitly declared client contract expectations against registered server routes (Part 34E baseline).

layer2_w008D0D9TaxonomyAudit.note: Audits 10 core standardized pioneer & Phase 1 endpoints under strict D0-D9 drift taxonomy (including method, path, param, schema, envelope, and auth).

summary.scopeNote: Audit is strictly restricted to 10 declared endpoints under D0-D9 taxonomy. Does not prove zero drift across the entire 138-route catalog.
